summary: 碳足迹衡量某项活动或产品引起的温室气体排放，书中的数字都是估算。作者把能追踪具体环节的生命周期分析与覆盖面较广的投入产出分析结合，以减轻资料缺漏和行业平均值过粗的问题。
logic: 生命周期分析追踪环节
投入产出分析覆盖供应链

paragraphs.brief: 由于这本书是关于如何衡量某些事物的碳足迹，我首先要阐明我指的是什么。
sentences: As this book is about ways of measuring the carbon footprint of particular things, I should start by making it clear what I mean.
由于这本书是关于如何衡量某些事物的碳足迹，我首先要阐明我指的是什么。
I am using the word ‘carbon’ as shorthand for all the different global-warming greenhouse gases, and I am using the word ‘footprint’ as a metaphor for the total impact that something has.
我使用“碳”一词作为所有全球升温温室气体的简称，我使用“脚印”一词作为某种物质产生的总影响的一个隐喻。
So I am using the phrase ‘carbon footprint’ as shorthand to mean the full climate-change impact of something.
因此我用“碳足迹”这一短语作为直截了当的缩略语来表示某种东西对气候变化的全部影响。
That something could be anything – an activity, an item, a lifestyle, a company, a country, or even the whole world.
任何事物都可能发生一种活动一种物品一种生活方式一种公司一个国家甚至整个世界

paragraphs.brief: 碳足迹的测量远不是精确的过程，不论声称，或任何数字你可能看到书面产品边在一些商店。
sentences: Measuring carbon footprints is a long way from being an exact process, whatever the claims, or whatever numbers you might see written on the side of products in some shops.
碳足迹的测量远不是精确的过程，不论声称，或任何数字你可能看到书面产品边在一些商店。
All my numbers are best estimates, and nothing more, even though I have reached them as carefully as I can.
我的所有数字都是最好的估计，仅此而已，尽管我已经尽可能小心地到达了他们。

paragraphs.brief: 我使用了各种不同的方法和来源。
sentences: I have used a variety of different methods and sources.
我使用了各种不同的方法和来源。
I have drawn on a range of data sets and models taken from publicly available reports of life-cycle* studies.
我从公开提供的生命周期研究报告* 中提取了一系列数据集和模型。
I have also used studies carried out for businesses across different industries by my own company, Small World Consulting, using models that we are developing all the time.
我还利用我自己的公司小世界咨询公司为不同行业的企业进行的研究，利用我们一直在开发的模式。
Often I have arrived at numbers by a couple of different routes, to check that the results agree with each other.
我经常通过几条不同的路线到达数字，以核实结果是否相互一致。
Occasionally, it has been more a case of putting my finger in the air and guessing, but when that has been the case I have tried to make it clear.
有时，这更像是将我的手指放在空中和猜想中，但是当情况如此时，我试图表明这一点。

paragraphs.brief: 但对于所有的问题，基于过程的生命周期分析仍然是无法以任何其他方式收集的详细信息的重要来源。
sentences: The publicly available data sets I have used were arrived at by two main methods.
我使用的公开数据集是用两种主要方法得出的。
The first of these, process-based life-cycle analysis, is the most common approach to carbon footprint calculations.
第一项基于过程的生命周期分析是计算碳足迹的最常见方法。
It is often referred to as ‘bottom-up’ because you start off identifying, one by one, all the processes that have had to happen in order for, say, a product to be created.
它常常被称为“自下而上”，因为你开始逐个地发现所有必须发生的过程，例如，为了创造产品。
Then you add up the emissions from each process, and that is the footprint of the product.
然后将每种工艺的排放量加在一起，这就是产品的足迹。
It may sound simple, but it is not at all.
听起来可能很简单，但一点也不简单。
It is back-breaking work, and since the number of processes you really need to include is always infinite, the job is never quite complete, so you end up with an underestimate.
这是一种倒退式的工作，因为你真正需要包括的流程数量总是无限的，所以工作从来就没有完全完成过，所以最后你低估了。
In fact, the omissions from the calculation are often shocking: they can be fifty per cent or more.
事实上，计算过程中的遗漏往往令人震惊：可能达50%或以上。
To make matters worse, these problems are commonly overlooked, even in the development of government-backed and government-funded guidelines, such as the UK’s PAS 2050 standard.
更糟糕的是，这些问题通常被忽视，甚至在制定政府支持和政府资助的准则，如联合王国的《2050年考绩制度》标准时也是如此。
But for all the problems, process-based life-cycle analysis is still an essential source of detailed information that can’t be gathered any other way.
但对于所有的问题，基于过程的生命周期分析仍然是无法以任何其他方式收集的详细信息的重要来源。

paragraphs.brief: 投入产出分析的关键“trick”是一套天才数学(一个叫Wassily Leontief的人获得了诺贝尔奖)，它成功地以百分之百完整的方式捕捉了无穷的波纹效应。
sentences: The other method is environmental input-output analysis.
另一种方法是环境投入-产出分析。
This is a neat alternative to process-based life-cycle analysis.
这是基于过程的生命周期分析的简单替代方法。
It is not as popular, perhaps because it is a bit less easy to understand, but it is at least as robust as anything else in the dim world of measuring carbon footprints.
它并不那么受欢迎，或许是因为它不太容易理解，但至少在测量碳足迹的暗淡世界中，它比任何其他东西都强大。
It is sometimes called a ‘top-down’ approach because it begins by looking at the whole economy.
有时它被称为“自上而下”的方法，因为它从整个经济开始。
It uses macroeconomic modelling to understand the way in which the activities of one industry trigger activities and emissions in every other industry.
它利用宏观经济模型来了解一个行业的活动如何引发其他行业的活动和排放。

Input-output analysis’ key ‘trick’ is a piece of ingenious maths (for which a man called Wassily Leontief got a Nobel Prize) that succeeds in capturing the endless ripple effects in a way that is one hundred per cent complete.
投入产出分析的关键“trick”是一套天才数学(一个叫Wassily Leontief的人获得了诺贝尔奖)，它成功地以百分之百完整的方式捕捉了无穷的波纹效应。
It has the further advantage that if you know how much something costs, you can get an instant crude estimate of its carbon footprint.
还有一个好处是如果你知道要花多少钱就能对碳足迹进行即时的粗略估计
It is like a magic trick.
这就像一个魔术。
And just like all the best magic it is also a bit too good to be true – in many cases the results can be ridiculously general and of little value.
和所有最好的魔法一样，它也有点太好而不能真实 — — 在许多情况下，其结果可能是荒谬的笼统的，而且价值很小。

paragraphs.brief: 然而，投入-产出分析是一种自然的方法，既因为它不省略事物，又因为一旦建立了具体模型，它往往就很容易使用：基本技术已经确立。
sentences: Input-output analysis is nevertheless a natural method, both because it does not omit things, and because once a specific model has been built it is often easy to use: the basic technique is well established.
然而，投入-产出分析是一种自然的方法，既因为它不省略事物，又因为一旦建立了具体模型，它往往就很容易使用：基本技术已经确立。
The specific model I have used is one that was developed at Small World Consulting in collaboration with Lancaster University in the UK, and draws mainly on data obtained from government sources.
我使用的具体模式是在小世界咨询公司与联合王国兰开斯特大学合作开发的，主要利用从政府来源获得的数据。
It was based on a 2007 picture of the UK economy.
其依据是2007年联合王国经济情况。
It deals with all the greenhouse gases, and employs a weighting factor for gases emitted at a high altitude, which have a greater impact than ground-level emissions.
它涉及所有温室气体，对高空排放的气体采用加权系数，其影响大于地面排放。

A key weakness, which I sometimes adjust for, is that it treats imported products as though they had the same carbon intensity as products from within the UK, whereas in reality imports are usually more carbon-intensive.
我有时会加以调整的一个关键弱点是，它把进口产品当作与联合王国国内产品具有相同的碳密度，而实际上进口产品通常更需要碳密集。

paragraphs.brief: 大部分时间我使用生命周期分析和输入输出分析的组合来获取我的数字。
sentences: Most of the time I have used a combination of life-cycle analysis and input-output analysis to get my numbers.
大部分时间我使用生命周期分析和输入输出分析的组合来获取我的数字。
At its best, life-cycle analysis can be more precise, but input-output analysis is often able to get at information that life-cycle analysis is unable to reach.
在最佳情况下，寿命周期分析可以更加精确，但投入产出分析往往能够获得生命周期分析无法达到的信息。
Putting the two methods together is sometimes called a hybrid approach, and the result is a bit like looking through both a microscope and a telescope at the same time.
将这两种方法结合起来有时被称为混合方法，结果有点像同时通过显微镜和望远镜看。
They each show you different things, and between them, if the lenses are clean, you end up with a passable understanding of whatever it is you are looking at.
每个人展示不同的东西，彼此之间，如果镜头是干净的，你最终有一个可以传递的理解它是什么你正在看。
